metadata.question: Does the nighttime light intensity in Aleppo, Syria decrease in 2016 compared to 2012?

data.raw_code: The user asks: "Does the nighttime light intensity in Aleppo, Syria decrease in 2016 compared to 2012?" I need to analyze nighttime light data in Aleppo, Syria for 2012 and 2016. Strategy: 1. Collection: Use VIIRS nighttime lights data (monthly composites). The collection is "NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMSLCFG". The band is 'avg_rad'. 2. Dates: 2012-01-01 to 2012-12-31 and 2016-01-01 to 2016-12-31. 3. Location: Aleppo, Syria. I'll use a point near the city center with a buffer of 10 km to cover the urban area. Coordinates: ~37.1343°E, 36.2021°N (based on Aleppo's location). 4. Masking: Nighttime lights don't have clouds, but we need to handle missing data (months with no coverage). 5. Processing: For each year, compute the mean radiance within the buffer. 6. Check: If no images in either year → C1. If images exist but 0 valid pixels after masking → C2 (unlikely since no cloud masking needed). If results are null/NaN → C3. 7. Final answer: If 2016 mean < 2012 mean → A (Yes), else → B (No). Potential issues: - VIIRS data starts in 2012 (April 2012). So 2012 might have partial coverage. I should check collection size. - Alternative: Use DMSP-OLS for 2012, but VIIRS is better for comparison because it's the same sensor type (though DMSP and VIIRS are different). I'll stick with VIIRS for both years for consistency. - The collection "NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMSLCFG" has data from 2012-04 to present. I'll write code accordingly. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions var aleppo = ee.Geometry.Point(37.1343, 36.2021).buffer(10000); // 10km buffer around Aleppo var start2012 = '2012-01-01'; var end2012 = '2012-12-31'; var start2016 = '2016-01-01'; var end2016 = '2016-12-31'; // 2. Data Acquisition - VIIRS Monthly Nighttime Lights var viirs = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMSLCFG') .select('avg_rad'); // average radiance band var col2012 = viirs.filterDate(start2012, end2012).filterBounds(aleppo); var col2016 = viirs.filterDate(start2016, end2016).filterBounds(aleppo); // Check collection sizes var size2012 = col2012.size().getInfo(); var size2016 = col2016.size().getInfo(); console.log('2012 Images:', size2012); console.log('2016 Images:', size2016); // If either collection is empty, try alternative collection (DMSP for 2012) if (size2012 === 0 || size2016 === 0) { // Try DMSP for 2012 if VIIRS is empty if (size2012 === 0) { var dmsp2012 = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/DMSP-OLS/NIGHTTIME_LIGHTS') .filterDate('2012-01-01', '2012-12-31') .filterBounds(aleppo) .select('stable_lights'); var dmspSize = dmsp2012.size().getInfo(); console.log('DMSP 2012 Images (fallback):', dmspSize); if (dmspSize > 0) { col2012 = dmsp2012; size2012 = dmspSize; } else { console.log('No data for 2012.'); console.log('C1'); return; } } if (size2016 === 0) { console.log('No data for 2016.'); console.log('C1'); return; } } // 3. Processing - Create composites (mean) and count valid pixels var img2012 = col2012.mean(); var img2016 = col2016.mean(); // Count valid pixels (pixels > 0, since radiance can be 0) var count2012 = img2012.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: aleppo, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('avg_rad').getInfo(); var count2016 = img2016.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: aleppo, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('avg_rad').getInfo(); console.log('Valid pixels 2012:', count2012); console.log('Valid pixels 2016:', count2016); if (count2012 === 0 || count2016 === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels after processing.'); console.log('C2'); return; } // 4. Calculation - Mean radiance var mean2012 = img2012.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: aleppo, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('avg_rad').getInfo(); var mean2016 = img2016.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: aleppo, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('avg_rad').getInfo(); console.log('Mean radiance 2012:', mean2012); console.log('Mean radiance 2016:', mean2016); // 5. Validation & Final Answer if (mean2012 === null || mean2016 === null || isNaN(mean2012) || isNaN(mean2016) || mean2012 < 0 || mean2016 < 0) { // radiance shouldn't be negative console.log('Invalid calculation result.'); console.log('C3'); return; } // Check if 2016 is less than 2012 if (mean2016 < mean2012) { console.log('Nighttime light intensity decreased.'); console.log('A'); } else { console.log('Nighttime light intensity did not decrease.'); console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
